title: Extreme crash sends stoplights crashing to ground (2021)
description:
Photo here of troopers investigating the next day: https://twitter.com/SafetyAlertsMN/status/1442935673678299137

"Acura was traveling Southbound Highway 65 approaching Medtronic Parkway at a high rate of speed crossing into the Northbound lanes and hitting the semaphore in the northeast corner of the intersection."


Additional information about this crash will be posted here:
https://app.dps.mn.gov/MSPMedia2/IncidentDisplay/24511

transcript.text: Absolutely huge crash last night. 9.50 p.m. or around then in the city of Fridley and the north metro, Highway 65, just north of Interstate 694. One person tried to, they had to completely block off the road, but one person went the wrong way, tried to get around the closed off roadway. Of course, they immediately got pulled over. Again, Highway 65, last night. This individual, this driver, It looked like they did get a ticket. I saw paper in their, then they, paper in the officer's hand. Then they did have to tear down the entire pole going across the highway or that arterial roadway. Because there's so much damage to it, you can see actually two stoplights and a sign crashed to the ground. So they brought out heavy machinery to get this fully taken down. Just the one vertical pole remains. This is an arterial highway, so it has intersections. but near highway speed, so they're very dangerous, and those poles are fixed. Those stoplight poles are fixed. The roadway poles are breakaways. And you can see the impact on the morning commute because this was converted to a four-way stop. So those inbound commuters had a big impact. Check a link in the description for updates on this crash in the driver condition. Like, subscribe, and share. Stay informed. Stay safe.
